value.rationale: For transport through periodic two-mobility media the rate inventory fixes average current but does not fix noise. The all-period extremal theorem identifies both optimal construction principles, their exact equality cases and limiting regimes. This is a motivated optimization of an established nonequilibrium physical observable, not a small numerical improvement or a generic coefficient formula.
